binary_scope_review.reason: Exact reviewed quote-use packages only qualify caller-supplied tokens inside the host-side attribute parser used to build get-size-derive2. Final target GetSize templates use ordinary quote and belong to get-size-derive2. Actual license/copyright text remains unresolved; declared MIT is not verified. This exclusion applies only to the distributed binaries and their attribution bundle, never to source or build-cache distributions.
evidence: quote-use@0.8.4 src/lib.rs:79-142: wrappers delegate caller tokens to quote_use_impl; no independently supplied target implementation.
attribute-derive-macro@0.10.5 src/lib.rs:911-978: parser templates serve host-side StructFieldAttribute in get-size-derive2@0.11.0 src/lib.rs:6-18,323-324.
get-size-derive2@0.11.0 src/lib.rs:355-384: final target GetSize templates use ordinary quote, not quote-use.
Pinned worker macro fingerprints have compile_kind 0 (host); absence of quote_use symbols in the unstripped worker is corroboration only, not the exclusion criterion.

For every selected artifact and worker target, require absence from normal,build,no-proc-macro reachability and exact incoming edges, identities/checksums, macro boundaries, and reviewed Rust source hashes throughout the consumer chain.
